description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a neural-specific basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) transcription factor that can specify a neuronal fate on ectodermal cells and is expressed in neural progenitor cells within the developing central and peripheral nervous systems. The protein product of this gene also plays a role in the differentiation and survival of midbrain dopaminergic neurons. [provided by RefSeq, Apr 2012].

uniprot_function.text: Transcriptional regulator. Involved in neuronal differentiation. Activates transcription by binding to the E box (5'-CANNTG-3').
